pillarOverview.title: Software Engineering & Technology Services
pillarOverview.tagline: Delivering Dependable Software, Modernization, and Systems Integration
pillarOverview.description: We help businesses design, build, modernize, maintain, and optimize software systems. From early-stage web platforms to enterprise backend services, our engineering approach emphasizes clarity, maintainability, sensible architecture, and honest communication.
principles: Simplicity over needless complexity: choose the simplest architecture that solves the problem.
Code maintainability: write software that another competent engineer can understand, modify, and test.
Disciplined testing: regression prevention and automated tests are essential parts of delivery, not afterthoughts.
Transparent scope management: clear requirements, documented interfaces, and no unsupported commitments.

services.fullDescription: We partner with organizations to translate business goals into working, dependable software. Enterprise teams requiring dedicated web applications

Clean, modular architectures using battle-tested enterprise frameworks, typed frontends, and robust database layers.
Strict inclusion of unit and integration test suites as standard release deliverables.
Documented deployment procedures and clean handover of all source repositories.

Accumulated technical debt making every new minor feature slow, risky, and expensive to ship.
Outdated runtime versions, libraries, and frameworks introducing unpatched security vulnerabilities.

synezaSolution: Systematic codebase triage, error log analysis, and root-cause remediation rather than surface-level band-aids.
Safe, incremental dependency updates with automated regression verification.
Targeted code refactoring that simplifies high-complexity functions and untangles spaghetti logic.
Creation of automated integration tests that lock in expected behavior before major modifications.

services.name: Application Modernization
services.shortDescription: Pragmatic, value-guided modernization of legacy codebases: monolith modularization, framework upgrades, and API decoupling without high-risk rewrites.
services.fullDescription: Big-bang rewrites are notoriously high-risk, expensive, and frequently fail to replicate subtle legacy business logic. Our application modernization practice focuses on incremental, value-driven evolution. We assess existing architectures, isolate core domain modules, modernize database access, and upgrade underlying frameworks while preserving continuous business operations.
targetAudience: Established businesses with critical legacy applications
Organizations running unsupported legacy runtime versions and outdated frameworks
Teams facing high deployment friction and architectural gridlock
businessProblem: Tightly coupled monolithic codebases where a minor change in one area breaks unrelated features.
Legacy runtime and framework versions blocking modern infrastructure adoption and security patching.
Slow release cycles requiring all developers to coordinate massive, risky all-hands deployments.
synezaSolution: Architecture assessment and domain boundary discovery using Strangler Fig and modular patterns.
Pragmatic modularization: extracting discrete API services only where business value justifies it.
Runtime and framework upgrades executed with backward compatibility checks and safety nets.
Containerization and CI/CD improvements that speed up deployment cycles safely.
keyCapabilities: Legacy codebase assessment, static code analysis, and architectural review
Monolith modularization and bounded context isolation
Framework and runtime upgrades (runtime LTS migrations, enterprise framework baseline upgrades)
Database access modernization and query decoupling
API wrapper creation around legacy core logic to enable modern web/mobile frontends
Containerization, image optimization, and automated CI pipeline integration

services.name: Database Engineering & Optimization
services.shortDescription: Relational and document schema modeling, SQL query tuning, index strategy, database migrations, and transaction integrity assurance.
services.fullDescription: Your database is the definitive source of truth for your business operations. Our database engineering services help organizations design clean schemas, tune sluggish queries, structure indexing strategies, and execute safe migrations with rollback planning, automated validation, and zero unverified data assumptions.
targetAudience: Teams undertaking complex schema migrations or version upgrades
businessProblem: Slow database queries causing page timeouts and degrading user experience during peak hours.
Unindexed tables and poorly constructed joins consuming excessive CPU and memory.
High fear of executing database migrations due to potential data loss or locking.
synezaSolution: In-depth query profiling and execution plan analysis (EXPLAIN) to eliminate table scans.
Thoughtful indexing strategies that accelerate reads without penalizing write throughput.
Safe, repeatable migration scripts (Flyway / Liquibase) with automated rollback steps.
Strict transaction isolation reviews to prevent dirty reads, phantom rows, or race conditions.
keyCapabilities: Database schema design, normalization, and relational modeling
Query optimization, slow-query log analysis, and execution plan profiling
Composite index design and index bloat remediation
Database migration planning, testing, and execution with rollback provisions
Data access layer refactoring (ORM optimization, eliminating N+1 query patterns)
Data integrity constraints, foreign key validation, and transactional audits

deliveryApproach.title: Profiling & Performance Baseline
deliveryApproach.description: Analyze slow query logs, connection pools, and table statistics to find hot spots.

deliveryApproach.title: Optimization & Query Refactoring
deliveryApproach.description: Rewrite complex queries, adjust indexes, and eliminate N+1 ORM bottlenecks.

deliveryApproach.title: Staging Benchmarking
deliveryApproach.description: Benchmark performance improvements on realistic dataset replicas before production release.

deliveryApproach.title: Production Cutover & Verification
deliveryApproach.description: Apply changes during designated windows with verifiable rollback scripts ready.

benefits: Significantly speeds up response times for key business reports and customer screens.
Prevents costly over-provisioning of cloud database instances.
Protects business-critical records with tested migration safety nets.
